## Decision
- **Recommended: BLANCO PLEON 6 (white 521683)** (Singapore price TBC; Blanco dealer Hoe Kee) — inset SILGRANIT single bowl, bowl 54.5 × 40, 22 deep. The rim covers the stone cut-out, so no polished cut-out edge; the continuous tap ledge along the back has its own tap hole.
- **Colour**: white 521683 comes with a 3½" InFino waste set; soft white 527772 is the "for coloured components" version, sold without the waste set, so the colour-matched waste parts are bought separately.
- **Alternative (earlier suggestion): Franke Box BXX 210/110-54 (127.0677.190)** (S$650 at Econflo; web store shows it sold out) — choose it for stainless steel, undermount and no worry about heavy pots. Bowl 54 × 41, 20 deep, R12; the tap needs its own hole in the worktop.
- **Rejected: Franke Maris MRG 110-62** — undermount, and Franke specifies a worktop of at least 20 mm, so the 1.2 slab would need building up.
- **Rejected: Blanco Solis 500-U, Subline 500-U** — bowls only 50; the Subline 500-U starts at S$908.
- **Rejected: Franke Mythos MYX 110-55, Box 210-72, Felix FEX 110-70, Solis 700-U** — official minimum cabinet 80, so they don't fit the 71.9 cabinet.

## Criteria
- **Usable bowl size**: width ≥ 50, front-to-back ≥ 40, depth ≥ 18. A Ø28 stock pot is about 38 across its handles and must lie flat for rinsing.
- **Cabinet width**: official minimum cabinet ≤ 71.9 (scheme A sink cabinet 71.9, scheme B 76.9). The PLEON 6 needs 60, so both work.
- **Ease with a 1.2 sintered slab**: inset only needs a cut hole, hidden under the rim; undermount needs a polished cut-out edge and bonded fixings, and a non-through-body slab shows a different-colour edge.
- **Tap position**: the tap sits on the sink's ledge, so no extra hole in the stone.
- **Durability and noise**: granite composite is quiet and scratch-resistant but a dropped heavy pot can chip it; stainless shrugs off knocks but shows fine scratches.
- **Waste**: 3½" waste; the trap needs a dishwasher spigot.

## Do first
- **Quote and order**: WhatsApp Hoe Kee on +65 8779 5626 for the price and lead time of the BLANCO PLEON 6 white 521683 (its website lists only the PLEON 8 at S$642 and PLEON 9 at S$686, so the PLEON 6 must be asked for). See Blanco in person at Hoe Kee Superstore, 1 Jalan Berseh #01-09 to #01-13 New World Centre, daily 10:00–19:00.
- **For the stone fabricator**: cut the 59.5 × 49 hole from the template supplied with the sink; support the narrow strips of slab in front of and behind the cut-out on timber rails; seal under the rim with neutral-cure silicone.
- **For the carpenter**: add two rails across the top of the sink cabinet, front and back, to carry the slab and sink; drill the dishwasher hose hole at the lower back of the sink cabinet's side panel; keep the half-depth front shelf clear of the trap.
- **Tap**: choose a single-hole pull-out tap for the PLEON 6's tap hole; its height must clear the window sash's opening range.
- **Trap**: the waste set has no trap; buy one with a dishwasher spigot.

## Risks and open items
- PLEON 6 Singapore price, stock and warranty are **TBC**; European reference price €335 (Hornbach Austria).
- Whether the factory fixing clips cover a 12 mm worktop is **TBC**; if not, the fabricator bonds timber battens under the slab to bring it into the clip range.
- The PLEON 6 is 51 front-to-back; check the remaining front and back strips when the worktop depth is fixed.
- A dropped heavy pot can chip a granite-composite sink.

## In one line
- **BPI2638UB** = power model: two 3.6 kW zones (incl. a 28 cm large zone), **needs a dedicated 32A circuit**, 7.4 kW total. S$1,459–1,480.

en.## 結論\n- **選：Apple Home 單一 App＋Aqara Hub:
## Decision
- **Pick: Apple Home as the only app + Aqara Hub M3 (Zigbee backbone) + the HomePod mini already owned as the home hub (S$0)** — switches, sensors and light strips run Zigbee to M3, bridged into Apple Home via HomeKit; the HomePod mini handles remote access, automations, HKSV analysis, Thread border routing and Matter control.
- **The Frame cannot replace the hub**: the Apple TV on the TV is only a streaming app (plus AirPlay 2); Samsung TVs never appear in Apple Home's home-hub list and are not Apple Thread border routers. Only a HomePod, HomePod mini or Apple TV box can be the hub. The Frame has its own SmartThings hub (with Matter/Thread), but that is a second app and is not needed.
- **Alternative: Apple TV 4K (4th generation, A19, Wi-Fi + Ethernet, S$399, in stores 13 Nov)** — buy only if HKSV events from the three E1s are often missed or late, or the HomePod mini often shows 'No Response'; it then becomes the active hub automatically and the HomePod mini goes to standby.
- **No second HomePod mini**: Apple uses only one active hub at a time; M3 is already a second Thread border router. Buy one later only for bedroom audio.
- **Alternative architecture: everything Matter over Thread, direct** — 86-box Thread switches and UK-plug Thread plugs have almost no local stock in Singapore; revisit in 2–3 years.
- **Rejected: Aqara Home as the main app; extra Hue / SwitchBot / Tuya hubs** — another account and another failure point.
- **Network: UniFi U7 Lite ×2 + Cloud Gateway Ultra (S$219) + USW Lite 8 PoE** — the gateway replaces the ISP router and runs UniFi Network; without it APs run in standalone mode, configured one by one, with no fast roaming or remote management. Buy: UI Store SG online, or authorised reseller Win-Pro (38 Jalan Pemimpin #07-04 M38); no shop with display units found.
- **Main-door scene button: Aqara Wireless Remote Switch H1 (Double Rocker), S$45** — single/double/long press per rocker + both together, up to 7 Apple Home scenes; battery about 5 years, no wiring.
- **No UPS**: Singapore's 2024 SAIDI was 0.26 minutes per customer, under 1 minute of outage a year on average.
- **iCloud+ 200 GB**: required for HKSV on 3 E1 cameras (50 GB allows 1, 200 GB up to 5); recordings do not count against storage.
- **By category**: switches Aqara Smart Wall Switch H1 EU (with neutral); cameras Aqara Camera E1 + HKSV; plugs Tapo P110M; lights plain downlights + Aqara LED Strip T1; sensors Aqara door sensor + Motion Sensor P1.

## Criteria
- **Works offline**: wall switches cut power directly; the scene button runs on the HomePod mini locally, no internet needed.
- **One app, easy family sharing**: daily use is Apple Home only; family are invited with Apple accounts, no Aqara account.
- **Singapore stock and warranty**: BS 86 mm boxes, BS1363 plugs, 12–36-month local warranty; imports only when there is no alternative.
- **≤ 2 hubs, reuse what is owned**: HomePod mini + M3; no other device may need its own hub.
- **Native Apple Home features**: Adaptive Lighting requires HomeKit bridging (lost via Matter bridging); cameras need HKSV.
- **Power-loss recovery**: switches set to power-off memory so lights stay off; no UPS (outages are very rare in Singapore).
- **Long-term support**: models on the market ≥ 2 years and still updated (H1, E1, M3).

## Next steps
- **Tell the electrician (switches)**: neutral N to every switch box; 86 mm square boxes ≥ 35 mm deep; max 2 circuits per H1 plate.
- **Tell the electrician (strips and network)**: always-live power at each strip driver; one Cat6 at the TV cabinet for M3 (PoE) + one spare for a future Apple TV.
- **HomePod mini placement**: central living room, near an AP, not inside a closed cabinet; it becomes the hub automatically once set up.
- **Setup**: add M3 to Apple Home with the HomeKit QR and do not add it again via Matter; set M3's Thread to join Apple's network; Zigbee channel 25, 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi fixed on 1 or 6; keep HomePod mini, cameras and plugs on one subnet.
- **Main-door scene button**: Wireless Remote Switch H1 double rocker; left single press 'Leave' (all lights and plugs off), right single press 'Arrive', the rest custom.

## Risks and open items
> ⚠️ HomePod mini is Wi-Fi only: if Wi-Fi drops, remote access and Apple Home automations stop; wall switches and M3 local automations keep working.
> ⚠️ HKSV analysis runs on the hub; Apple does not publish how many cameras a HomePod mini can handle (TBC). If the three E1s often miss events, that is the signal to buy an Apple TV.
> ⚠️ HomePod mini and M3 are both Thread border routers; M3 must join Apple's network or the mesh splits in two.
> ⚠️ Hub M3 is a single point of failure: switches still work by hand, but app control and automations for Aqara devices (including the scene button) stop.
- HKSV records events only, not 24/7; continuous recording relies on the E1's microSD. Camera E1 is 2.4 GHz only.
- Apple Home does not yet support Matter cameras (2026-10, TBC).
- Kid's-room camera: stop streaming and recording when someone is home.

en.## 結論\n- **選：YU HOME SMARTLUX LITE**（S$5:
## Verdict
- **Pick: YU HOME SMARTLUX LITE** (S$549, list S$899, concrete-ceiling installation included; yuhome.com.sg). 113 × 40 × 6.6 with a one-piece hanging frame that doesn't telescope, so its length always fits within 150. 25 W dual-tone light with adjustable brightness. No fan, no heater. 2-year on-site warranty, 5 years on the motor.
- **Alternative: 米家智能双控晾衣机 2** (crowdfunding ¥1,399, about S$420–575 landed). It has the strongest light: 50 W, 3000 lm, 2700–5700K, CRI 97. It is 7 cm thick, and the two rods rise and lower separately. The problem is that Xiaomi states brightness and colour temperature are set only in the Mijia App. If you choose it, set 2700K and the brightness once in the App at installation; after that the remote only switches the light on and off.
- **Head to head**: both are slim, neither has a heater, and the prices are similar. SMARTLUX LITE wins on a confirmed length, local installation and warranty, and light control without the App. Mijia wins on a brighter, warmer light and telescopic rods.
- **Rejected: Aqara 智能晾衣机 H1**: the only model confirmed to have brightness ± and colour-temperature ± keys on the remote, but it has air drying, heated drying and UV, draws 750 W, and is 9.5 cm thick.
- **Rejected: 米家智能晾衣机 2 / 3, 米家智能双控晾衣机 (first gen), 米家智能晾衣机 Pro**: dimming and colour temperature are App-only, and the remote has only 4 basic keys. 晾衣机 2 is 9.1 cm thick.
- **Rejected: 米家智能晾衣机 1S, 米家智能隐形晾衣机 双杆2.4米, 米家智能晾衣机 3 Max**: the 1S is 9.9 cm thick; the other two are 2.2–2.4 m long and don't fit.
- **Rejected: Aqara 智能晾衣机 Lite, 邦先生 轻空 M31C**: the Lite has a 20 W single-colour-temperature light; the M31C dims only through the App or voice.
- **Rejected: Philips 3000 Series SDR301, Panasonic JM-BB6AW / JM-EN6UW**: the Philips remote only switches the light on and off. Panasonic installs only through dealers in China and doesn't publish its remote keys.
- **Rejected: PRISM+ Solaris XL, Steigen Solar, GoodLiving Platinum Mini 2.0, GoodWife Lite Mini**: the first three have fans and heaters, and the GoodWife poles extend to 180.
- 好太太, 晾霸, 九牧, 云米, 欧普, 鸿蒙智选: none of their published specs shows a slim, unheated model with remote dimming. No official specs were found for 米家智能晾衣机 3C 柔光版.

## Criteria
- **No fan, no heater**: it is only a hanging rack and balcony light; most laundry is tumble-dried.
- **Light control without the App**: the remote or a wall button switches the light, ideally with brightness and colour temperature too.
- **Thickness ≤ 8–10 cm**: the ceiling is exposed concrete, so the body is in plain view.
- **Length ≤ 150**: centred in the 165 depth with ≥ 7 at each end; telescopic rods must stay within 150.
- **Bright, warm light**: ≥ 2000 lm and down to 3000K or warmer, since it doubles as the main balcony light.
- **Total landed cost**: unit, GST, freight and installation added together.

## Comparison
| Item | SMARTLUX LITE | 双控晾衣机 2 | Aqara H1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Thickness | 6.6 cm | 7 cm | 9.5 cm |
| Body | 113 × 40 | ~115 × 45 | 128 × 31.5 |
| Rods | 113 frame | 2, telescopic | 145–247 |
| Fan/heat | None | None | Yes, 750 W |
| Light | 25 W dual-tone | 50 W 3000 lm | 18 W |
| CCT | 2 tones, K n/a | 2700–5700K | Adjustable |
| Remote dim | TBC | No, App | Yes, ± keys |
| Extras | BT speaker | Auto-lower | UV |
| Landed | S$549 installed | S$420–575 | Out |
| Warranty | 2 yr on-site | None | None |

## Do first
- **Before ordering (we WhatsApp YU HOME)**: ask for photos of both sides of the remote to confirm brightness and colour-temperature keys. If they're missing, switch to 米家智能双控晾衣机 2.
- **Order**: buy SMARTLUX LITE at yuhome.com.sg. In the installation booking, state "exposed concrete ceiling, long side square to the glass doors, cabinet end 20 from the storage-cabinet doors, centred in the 165 depth". Ceilings above 2.8 m add S$160.
- **Power (tell Patrick)**: with no heater, a standard 13A socket is enough and no FCU is needed. Run PVC trunking from the S-09 socket circuit up to the ceiling and about 1 m along to the cabinet end of the rack, and fit an IP66 outdoor 13A socket there. Paint the trunking the ceiling colour.
- **Remote**: stick it on the wall beside the balcony door, 120 above the floor.
- **Submit a renovation application to the MCST**, listing the balcony ceiling drilling and the surface trunking.

## Risks and to confirm
- **Remote keys**: the site lists adjustable brightness, a remote and an App, but not the key layout (TBC).
- **Colour temperature**: only "dual-tone" is stated; Kelvin and lumens are unpublished. 25 W gives about 2000–2500 lm (estimate).
- **Capacity**: the 113 frame doesn't extend, which suits 1–2 people; fold large duvets to hang them.
- **Open balcony**: YU HOME rates it for indoor use and allows sheltered outdoor spots; keep the body on the inner side out of the rain.
- **MCST rules**: the by-laws may restrict drying laundry on balconies (TBC).

## Control and power (verified)
- **SMARTLUX LITE**: comes with a remote. The site also lists an App, but lifting and the light switch are on the remote. The built-in Bluetooth speaker can be ignored.
- **米家智能双控晾衣机 2**: the official launch says stepless brightness and 2700–5700K colour temperature are set in the Mijia App; the remote only lifts and switches the light.
- **Power**: YU HOME accepts a light point (6 A) or a standard socket. P-06 comes from the S-09 socket circuit, not the ceiling-fan point, and is isolated at the breaker.

## Why the Singapore warranty doesn't matter here
- Buying in Singapore isn't about the warranty; the price is the same. SMARTLUX LITE lands at **S$549** including installation and GST.
- 米家智能双控晾衣机 2 from Taobao: ¥1,399 ≈ S$252, plus S$23 GST, S$45–100 sea freight and S$100–200 for an installer, about **S$420–575**, and you'd still have to find an installer and change the plug to BS1363.

## Criteria
- **Stand clearance**: base ≥ 3 from both the curtain pocket and the console.
- **Sofa to passage**: ≥ 70 preferred, never < 60.
- **Listening triangle**: 60–70° preferred; with stands outside a 210 console the spacing is at least about 238, so about 73° is the floor.
- **Symmetry**: TV, console and sofa on one axis; an off-centre sofa makes the two speakers arrive at different times.
- **Rear wall (R89)**: speaker backs 8 from the wall, KC62 back 6. The LS50 Wireless II is rear-ported and KEF publishes no minimum rear distance (to confirm); KEF Connect's wall-distance setting runs from < 10 cm to > 50 cm and compensates the bass → set < 10 cm (Wall Mode in expert mode); 8 leaves room for the rear-panel plugs to turn down into the S2 column. The KC62 is sealed and side-firing; KEF only asks for ≥ 7.7 between each driver and a wall, the back needs room just for the plugs → rear EQ on Wall; the driver facing the speaker is 8.7 from the stand base. Speaker fronts sit 5.9 behind the console front; the tweeter at about 81 is far above the 40 console top, so nothing blocks it.
- **Hidden cables**: each speaker plugs straight into a wall socket (KEF advises against extension strips); link cable and HDMI run in conduit.

- **Airflow (door shut, everyday)**: a hidden 48 × 4 hex-perforated aluminium plate (63 % open) + magnetic mesh filter in the bay floor above the plinth recess, in front of the toe light → network tray → plenum → fan; **AC Infinity CONTROLLER 1** (AC-PCA1, USB thermal trigger at 88 °F / 31 °C, on/off at full speed) on the S-22 USB port; the ≈ 20 W of 24 h network gear stays ≈ room +1 K. The filter lives only here: while playing the intake is the whole front at < 0.3 m/s.

The grille is screwed to the end-block battens from the cavity side, then the removable inner partition goes in; care: vacuum the slats monthly, and once a year remove the fan and vacuum the cavity through the Ø13.5 hole. Full-height version: 17 slats across 1.1–37.5 (from the wall) and 8.0–37.9 high, no rails, 6 mm black board behind everything outside the middle zone.
- **Scheme B: why ≈ 4.5 a side is enough for the PS5**: the PS5 Pro breathes in at the front and out at the back; to play, the flipper slides in and the whole 53.4 × 22 = 1,175 cm² front becomes the intake (≈ 0.3 m/s), the heat leaves the 15.6 rear plenum through the left-end NF-A14 — the sides are only passages, and Sony's 10 is a reference.
